replyContent: Thanks for the feedback! We have a handful of ownership confirmation steps to delete accounts because deleting/resetting the account is often one of the first things someone tries to do once they've gained access to another player's account. We don't want this process to be too tedious for honest requests, but we also want it to be secure.

replyContent: This has been discussed by the team a few times. While it would be more convenient for players actively looking to reset their hero, it would also be more dangerous in situations where another person has gained access to a player's login information. It's something we will likely discuss again someday, so thank you for the feedback!
